annotations.title: Calculate South African PAYE, UIF and net pay

description: Employees' tax (PAYE), UIF (employee and employer, with the monthly ceiling), SDL and net pay for one South African employee and pay period, using the SARS tax deduction tables (or the exact statutory-rates formula) for the right tax year. Handles age rebates, the medical scheme fees tax credit, retirement-fund deductions (s11F cap), travel allowance (80%/20%), bonuses (annual-payment method), commission and fringe benefits.

age.description: Age on the last day of the tax year (65+ and 75+ get extra rebates). Or give date_of_birth / id_number.

bonus.description: Bonus / annual payment paid in this period (3605), taxed by the SARS annual-payment method

employer_medical_aid.description: Medical aid paid by the employer for the employee (fringe benefit 3810)

id_number.description: SA ID number (only used to read the date of birth; not stored)

medical_aid_contribution.description: Employee's own medical aid contribution deducted from pay (source code 4005)

medical_aid_members.description: People on the medical aid including the employee (for the s6A tax credit)

method.description: tables = SARS monthly tax deduction tables (default); formula = exact statutory-rates calculation

other_deductions.description: Other non-tax deductions from net pay (loans, union fees…)

pay_date.description: Pay date / period end, YYYY-MM-DD (default today). Decides the tax year: March onwards → next year (2026-11-30 → 2027 tax year).

period.description: What the amounts are per (default monthly). Non-monthly amounts are converted to a monthly equivalent.

salary.description: Basic salary/wage for the pay period, in rand (before deductions)

tax_year.description: Tax year instead of pay_date, e.g. "2027" (1 March 2026 – 28 February 2027)

taxable_allowance.description: Other taxable allowance — cell phone, housing, tools (3713)

travel_allowance.description: Travel allowance (3701): 80% taxed through PAYE, or 20% if at least 80% business use

travel_business_80.description: True when the employer is satisfied the vehicle is used at least 80% for business

name: sa_paye_calculate
title: Calculate South African PAYE, UIF and net pay
